Plans & itineraries

Plan for rain or rough sea

Coastal weather changes fast. This page gives a land-based backup when water activities are not possible.

Updated · 28 Oktober 2026

Priority

Staff guidance

Always follow signs and staff. Sunny land weather does not guarantee a safe sea.

  • Do not enter water if restricted.
  • Delay crossings in bad weather.
  • Use land as a substitute.

Land

Alternatives

Walking the bay edge, panorama photos, and eating in Painan are still available in light rain.

Take shelter

Use simple stalls to shelter in heavy rain, then continue when it eases.

Timing

Watch the forecast

Check the official forecast 1–2 days before leaving and observe conditions on arrival.

Questions

Before you go

01May I go to the beach in rain?+

Light rain usually still allows walking and photos; avoid water activities.

02If waves are big?+

Do not enter water or board boats; use the land plan.

03If the crossing is cancelled?+

Use land alternatives like photos or eating in Painan.

04When is it safe to return?+

Follow staff guidance and watch the weather on arrival.
